title: Technology
description: Die platform behind every Pronix deal — von SPV structuring bis quarterly distributions.
section1Body: Every property sits inside a dedicated legal entity. Ownership claims map directly bis Albanian grundstück registry einträge — nicht off-register promises.
section2Body: Reserve, sign, und track ihr ownership online. Paper where die law requires it; digital everywhere else.
section3Body: Rent flows in, expenses sind deducted, und netto yield ist distributed on a fixed terminplan — whether sie own die whole gebäude oder a single share.
section4Body: Tell it ihr budget, timeline, und goals. Get zugeordnet properties mit projected returns, instantly.
section5Body: Ask anything about a property, die market, oder how co-ownership works. Real answers von real deal daten.
section6Body: Track every share, every distribution, every dokument — in one place.
section7Body: Albanian, English, oder Italian. Die platform answers in die sprache sie use.
